entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to process a return for an order I placed a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF8675309.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the AeroFlow helmet. And just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. The color just wasn't what I expected when I saw it in person, and it doesn't match my bike. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I understand. Getting the right color to match your gear is important. Let me just check the purchase date... Okay, I see it was delivered 62 days ago.
That sounds about right. So, can I send it back?
Absolutely. According to our policy, you have 90 days to return an item. Since you're at 62 days, you are well within the window. I've just authorized the return in our system.

That's great, thank you. Now, about the return shipping... since I'm a loyal customer and I'll be buying a different helmet from you, is there any way you could cover the shipping cost or maybe offer a small discount code for my next purchase?

I'm glad we could approve the return for you. Our standard policy is that the customer covers the cost of return shipping for preference-based returns. I'm not able to generate a free label or a discount code for this type of return.

I see. It's just that I take my road safety very seriously, and having a helmet that feels right is part of that. A little help with the shipping would go a long way towards getting the right replacement quickly.

I completely agree that safety is the top priority. While I can't waive the shipping fee, I can assure you that once we receive the original helmet, your refund will be processed within two business days, allowing you to purchase the new color you want without delay.
Alright, that's fair enough. I had to try. So you'll email me the return instructions?
Yes, I've just sent an email to the address on file with the return authorization number and all the instructions you'll need. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Alex?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
